description: We are a team of six Data Science and Software Engineering students building a web-based Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project combines lunar outpost simulations with an astronaut health monitor to explore resource management, mission decisions, sleep, and physical activity. We welcome motivated members interested in web development, UI/UX, data visualization, game development, and space science. Beginners eager to learn and collaborate are welcome!
